skill.summary: Your AI pet health companion — symptom checks, nutrition guidance, and training tips for dogs and cats.

latestVersion.changelog:
Pet Parent Assistant 1.0.0

- Initial release offering education and guidance for dog and cat owners.
- Provides symptom triage categories (urgent, soon, home care) to help users decide when to call the vet.
- Offers nutrition advice, food evaluation, ingredient guidance, and life-stage needs for both cats and dogs.
- Includes positive training and behavior tips for common dog and cat issues.
- Gives preventive care information (vaccinations, parasite control, dental, life-stage needs).
- Always emphasizes the importance of consulting a veterinarian for diagnosis or emergencies.
